items.title: Nessel Appeals DTE Power Deal for 1-Million-Home Saline Data Center
items.dek: Nessel and environmental groups ask the Court of Appeals to void the regulators' approval of DTE contracts that could shift more than $500 million in new infrastructure costs onto ratepayers while shielding the deals from public review.
items.judge_note: Major new development: Nessel has now filed the actual appeal in court with opening arguments, escalating beyond her earlier demand for answers from the PSC.
